title: Replicate top-layer copper 40 mm to the right
summary: Collects free Top and Multi layer copper and components with a filtered board iterator, copies each with Replicate or ReplicateWithChildren, adds the copy to the board and moves it by an X offset.
phrasings: duplicate copper objects on a PCB
copy a component with its pads
clone tracks and vias and shift them
add a copy of a primitive to the board

commands.name: ReplicateCopper
commands.description: Replicate Top and Multi layer copper by an X offset

commands.name: CountCopper
commands.description: Count the free Top and Multi layer objects ReplicateCopper copies (test aid)
